newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia closes tender for stakes in 152 firms.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia closes tender for stakes in 152 firms.

text.p: The Slovenian Development Fund, the state's restructuring agency, said on Wednesday it had closed the tender for stakes in 152 companies and accepted a joint offer by 23 Slovenian investment funds.
"The tender was closed successfully as the offer met the tender price of 18.4 billion tolars ($130.5 million)," Jana Bogdanovski, a spokeswoman of the Development Fund, told Reuters.
The tender was the second of its kind, following the first one in September when stakes in 162 companies were sold.
Tenders, where stakes in all firms are offered as one package, replaced former auctions where shares of companies with poor business results often remained unsold.
The Development Fund handles 20 percent of shares of all companies which have taken part in the country's privatisation process that involves about 1,500 firms.
Up to now 833 companies have been privatised, while another 493 are in the middle of the process. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
